sentences.text: 3.  Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that the FIR of this case was lodged by the victim herself against the two named accused including the present petitioner, wherein the allegations are made that she was brought up by her Bara-papa since her infancy in Ranchi, she resided in a tenanted house of the son of Bara-papa thereto his Bara-papa had used to visit there.
At that time she was in class fifth.
He (her Bara-papa) had done 2-3 times duskarm with her.
Thereafter, she took back to her village from Ranchi.
In her village, one Harish Purty came in her contact and she used to talk with Harish Purty over the mobile phone.
In February 2023 Harish Purty established physical relation with her forcibly.
Thereafter, on 15th November 2023, Harish Purty also established physical relation with her whereby she also became pregnant.
She told in regard to pregnancy to Harish Purty, thereafter he asked her not to talk further and stated her that the pregnancy was not on account of him.
Hence this FIR was lodged.

Bara-papa Sri Charan Hasda had established physical relation with her twice.
She told in regard to this occurrence to her sister and brother who brought her back to the village from the house of Bara-papa.
In village too Harish Purty began to talk over the mobile phone for three years.
They continued to talk to each other.
He came to the village of her in a festival, thereto he has established physical relation with her and thereafter on 15th November 2023, after that she became pregnant.
On being pregnant she told to her parents and they gave medications to abort but she failed.
Harish Purty also took to his house but after one week he asked her to go to the parent's house as hence this FIR was lodged.
5. This FIR was lodged by the victim herself and on the date of filing alleging of the FIR, the victim was sixteen-year-old.

Victim had stated that while she was in class fifth her Bara-papa had established physical relation twice when she was residing at the house of her Bara-papa and thereafter on being told by her brother and sister she came back to her own village.
Thereto Harish Purty came in her contact and he continued to establish the physical relation with her and whereby she became pregnant.
This statement of victim under Section 164 Cr.P.C. is also corroborated with the medical evidence wherein the pregnancy of 28 weeks 1 days shown and age of victim is 14 years.
Victim was medically examined on 28th May 2024.

Her statement is also corroborated with the statement of Phulo Hansda the mother of victim, Balsoi Hansda the father of the victim, in view of the above the bail petition of the petitioner is hereby rejected.

(Subhash Chand, J.) Nishant Sri Charan Hasda @ Sri Charan Hansda @ ... vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... Opp. ... on 13 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/157829444/
